subject: Pilot runway bridge request — procurement review causing PO lag
messages:
From: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@medicore.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Barnes <mbarnes@medicore.com>, procure@medicore.com
Date: 2027-07-10T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot access — PO in legal, request for short runway extension

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile for our summarization workload. We're about 80% through technical sign-offs, but legal routed the PO to procurement for additional vendor paperwork. That added an unexpected 7–10 day review.

We'd like to keep the pilot active so our engineers can finish the integration tests. Can Redwood provide a short runway extension or a small top-up of credits to cover the next 7 days? We estimate ~150k tokens over that period. If there are requirements on usage or a cap, let me know and we'll abide by it.

I've attached the current PO draft and the vendor form procurement requested. Happy to provide anything else. Apologies for the delay on our side.

—Sarah
Sarah Cole
Head of AI, Medicore
sarah.cole@medicore.com
(415) 555-0129

Attachments: PO_draft_Medicore.pdf (pdf), vendor_form.docx (docx)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@medicore.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-10T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access — PO in legal, request for short runway extension

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO draft. Totally understand procurement hiccups; we've seen this a lot.

Short answer: yes — we can do a limited top-up to keep the pilot live. Proposed approach:
- Provide a 7-day credit top-up capped at 200k tokens (covers your 150k estimate with a buffer).
- No billing or invoice changes; this will be applied as a one-off promotional credit tied to RDW-1539.
- We ask you to confirm acceptance of our standard pilot terms (link below) and share any compliance docs procurement needs.

I'm looping in Marcus (account lead) for the final sign-off and Stephanie from finance for recording/approval. If Marcus/Stephanie approve, we'll apply the credit within 24 hours and confirm the expiration date.

Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
(510) 555-0187

Related: https://app.redwood.ai/docs/temporary-credits-policy

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@medicore.com>
Date: 2027-07-11T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access — PO in legal, request for short runway extension

On Fri, Jul 10, 2027 at 4:05 PM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I'm looping in Marcus (account lead) for the final sign-off and Stephanie from finance for recording/approval.

Thanks — approved.
- Approve 7-day promotional credit: 200k token cap.
- Add note to deal RDW-1539: Credit applied to preserve pilot momentum; must convert or finalize PO within extension window.

Stephanie, please confirm internal ledger entry and any note for renewal triggers. Sarah — we'll apply the credit tomorrow morning and send a follow-up with the exact expiration timestamp.

Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachment: approval_note.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@medicore.com>, Michael Barnes <mbarnes@medicore.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Credits applied — Pilot runway extension (RDW-1539)

Hi Sarah and Michael — quick update: 

We applied the 200k-token promotional credit to your pilot (deal RDW-1539) this morning. Key notes:
- Credit amount: 200,000 tokens (applied 2027-07-12T10:00:00-07:00)
- Expiration: 2027-07-19T10:00:00-07:00 (7 days from application)
- Usage cap: system-enforced; we will notify both teams if you approach 90% consumption.

Marcus: thanks for the quick sign-off. Stephanie: please confirm the ledger entry when you have a moment.

Sarah — please confirm you received the credit and that everything is working from your side. If procurement clears earlier and you send a signed PO, we'll convert the pilot usage against the PO as discussed.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
(510) 555-0187
